# DSH Java Desktop (dsh-java-desktop) — Desktop client

> Tauri 2 + React 19 desktop client for DSH Java. Bundles the dsh-java agent runtime (JAR + JRE)
> and provides digital-human collaboration, A2A protocol, plugins, skills and approval UI.

Key capabilities:
- Bundled Agent Runtime: starts `dsh-java-app.jar` locally, allocates port, injects API key
- ReAct conversation UI with SSE streaming, Markdown, tools, approval cards
- Digital humans, rooms, A2A, plugins, skills (zip/Git), MCP, CLI sub-agents
- Feishu bot settings and mobile device pairing (short code + access toggle)
- Platform capability layer: transport / credential / native (Tauri or browser fallback)

Tech stack: Tauri 2 (Rust), React 19, Vite, TypeScript
Version: 0.2.2
Repository: https://github.com/linlannet/dsh-java-desktop
Related: dsh-java, dsh-java-plugins, dsh-java-mobile, dsh-java-release

Build: `npm install && npm run build`
Test:  `npm test` (vitest)
Boundary check: `npm run check:boundary`
Dev:   `npm run tauri:dev` / `npm run tauri:build`
Agent JAR: `npm run agent:copy`

Key paths:
- src/App.tsx, src/components/*, src/lib/*, src/platform/*
- src-tauri/ (Rust shell, tauri.conf.json, capabilities)
- resources/agent/ (bundled JAR + runtime)
- tests/unit/*, docs/

Docs:
- README.md / README.en.md
- docs/specs/mobile_app_evolution/
- AGENTS.md
